modeReason: The funding-shortfall story scores novelty 3 × magnitude 3 × breadth 2 = 18, clearing the balance-adjusted threshold of 8 required for an industry-dimension story (industry led the last three days), so today is a fresh slopper.
phrase: A big AI lab's new funding round fell far short of its goal. Fewer students are studying computer science, now that AI writes the code instead.
phraseAlternatives: An AI lab asked investors for $30 billion and got less than half. Fewer students are choosing computer science, since AI already writes the code.
A top AI lab's funding round missed its target by billions. Computer science enrollment is dropping too, now that AI can do the job first.
The latest AI funding round came in far under its goal. Meanwhile, fewer students want a computer science degree the AI might finish first.

brief.concept: A company building stretches upward to reach a funding-goal sign far above it, its coin stack stopping short of a dotted line, while across the scene students walk out of a classroom door past a small robot that sits alone, quietly typing code at a desk.
brief.metaphor: Money and talent are both pulling away from the AI industry at the same time.

cast.who: a company building reaching one arm upward toward a funding-goal sign set high above it
a stack of coins beside the building, stopping well short of a dotted goal line
a small robot sitting alone at a desk, typing code on a glowing screen
a line of human students walking out of a classroom door, backpacks on, glancing back

brief.composition: Split scene. Left half: a company building on a low platform, one arm stretched toward a tall sign marked with a dollar goal far overhead; its coin stack sits well below a dotted line marking the target. Right half: a plain classroom door, a line of students exiting with backpacks while a small robot sits undisturbed at a desk behind them, typing. Keep it to these four main elements, flat cut-paper shapes, soft shadows, no more than a few words of on-image text (the dotted goal line and a simple $ mark).
brief.alt: An illustration shows a company building reaching for a tall funding goal sign while its stack of coins falls short below a dotted line. Beside it, students walk out of a classroom door as a small robot sits alone, typing code at a desk.
